jobs.description:
Care Expert - France 🇫🇷

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

👩‍💻Helping our members

As a Care Expert, your primary mission is to transform member requests into delightful experiences. You'll be their trusted guide, providing:

✨ Meaningful solutions that make a real difference

⚡️ Swift, timely responses when they need you most

🎯 Crystal-clear, accurate information

🤝 Transparent and helpful guidance every step of the way

You'll dive into the fascinating world of healthcare, mastering both:

  • The intricacies of the French healthcare system

  • The unique needs of our B2B partners who've chosen Alan as their corporate health insurance provider

Your role sits at the heart of what makes Alan special – turning complex healthcare questions into simple, human experiences.

👷Improving Alan

🎯 Your time at Alan: A perfect balance

  • 80% dedicated to providing exceptional member support

  • 20% driving innovative Care projects tailored to your unique expertise

🚀 Project leadership opportunities

As an experienced Care Expert, you'll have the chance to:

✨ Drive Process Excellence

  • Identify and implement key improvements

  • Transform data insights into actionable solutions

  • Lead end-to-end implementation

👥 Team impact

  • Guide and inspire fellow Alaners

  • Build high-performing project teams

  • Shape the future of Care at Alan

🌟 Example of projects you might lead:

  • Design member empowerment initiatives that boost autonomy

  • Architect Care team structures for peak performance

  • Collaborate on cross-community product innovations

  • Help us grow by attracting top Care talent

Your projects will be shaped by your passions and expertise, making each role truly unique!

⭐ Join the Care team! ⭐️  

You will thrive at Alan if you:

  • Have a genuine passion for helping others and find joy in solving member challenges

  • Master French and English at a full working proficiency level (written and spoken)

  • Navigate technology with confidence and embrace digital tools

  • Feel at ease connecting with members across all channels - email, chat, and phone calls (call-back only)

  • Bring natural empathy and a calm presence to every interaction

  • Love taking initiative and turning ideas into action

  • Thrive in collaborative environments where you can both learn and share knowledge

  • Bonus: Already understand the French healthcare system (but don't worry if you don't - we're great teachers! 😉)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A1-B1 level range of our salary grid.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

     

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

 

You want to know more about Alan?

🙌 Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work`

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & AI Specialist
jobs.description:
Digital Marketing & AI Specialist

Are you ready to elevate our digital presence and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to scale high-quality marketing campaigns? We’re looking for a motivated, fast-paced professional who understands digital marketing fundamentals but also knows how to use AI tools efficiently to create, optimize, repurpose, and drive brand growth across multiple channels.

Who We Are

Manay CPA is a global, full-service accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Atlanta, GA. With over 20 years of experience and a diverse team across 4 continents, we proudly support individuals, entrepreneurs, and businesses of all sizes.

Our services include business formation, accounting, tax, payroll, audit, and HR solutions—delivered with a personalized, relationship-first approach. We partner with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate the complexities of business and finance with confidence.

Recognized as a Top 100 Small Business by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and a Top 25 Small Business of the Year by the COBB Chamber for four consecutive years, we’re trusted by both local and international clients. Our CEO, Burcu Bree Manay, was also named one of the Top 50 Women in Accounting for her leadership and impact in the field.

At Manay CPA, your growth is our purpose. Join a team where innovation, integrity, and global collaboration drive real success.

Learn more at www.manaycpa.com

We Offer

  • Competitive USD base salary

  • Fully remote work anywhere in Turkey

  • A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment

  • Opportunities to pioneer AI-driven marketing workflows and strategies

  • Excellent onboarding and ongoing training

  • Continued professional development and exposure to international B2B marketing

Responsibilities

Digital Marketing & Content

  • Plan, create, and publish engaging content across social media, blogs, the company website, email campaigns, and other digital marketing channels.
  • Write compelling, SEO-focused content including blog articles, landing pages, website copy, newsletters, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Repurpose content across multiple channels to maximize reach, engagement, and consistency.
  • Manage the marketing calendar and ensure campaigns are executed on schedule.
  • Create and update presentations, pitch decks, brochures, and other client-facing marketing materials while maintaining brand consistency.
  • Monitor campaign, content, and SEO performance, prepare regular reports, and recommend data-driven improvements.

AI, Automation & Marketing Innovation

  • Design, build, and optimize AI-powered marketing workflows using AI tools, automation platforms, and no-code solutions to improve productivity, scalability, and content quality.
  • Develop and maintain AI agents, reusable prompts, workflow templates, and standard operating procedures to support content creation, SEO research, campaign planning, reporting, and other recurring marketing activities.
  • Research, test, and implement new AI tools, integrations, APIs, and automation solutions that enhance marketing performance and operational efficiency.
  • Identify repetitive marketing processes and transform them into scalable, AI-assisted workflows.
  • Review AI-generated content for accuracy, factual correctness, brand consistency, and overall quality before publication.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies, digital marketing trends, and best practices, recommending new solutions that drive continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Have a bachelor’s degree in related fields such as Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Have a minimum of 2 years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, SEO, or social media management.

  • High proficiency and hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut) is a big plus.

  • Experience with B2B marketing or professional services (accounting, finance, legal, consulting) is a big plus.

  • Experience with marketing software/platforms (e.g., Canva, Semrush, Mailchimp, WordPress, Google Analytics) is a plus.

  • Native or professional proficiency in Turkish, combined with excellent written and verbal communication skills in Business English (Fluent) - All interviews will be conducted in English!

  • Have a strong eye for design, layout, brand consistency, and visual presentation.

  • Highly organized, have multi-tasking skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced environment.

  • Attention to detail and an analytical mindset to review performance data and suggest improvements.

  • High flexibility in working hours to align with US operations, global team schedules, and dynamic campaign launch timelines.

  • Location: Home office

  • Work hours will be based on US TIME ZONES (Eastern Time)

  • Travelling might be required.

Next Steps

If this opportunity sounds like a great fit, click Apply to submit your application.

As part of your application, please include your resume along with samples of your work, such as content pieces, social media posts, blog articles, landing pages, presentations, videos, or marketing campaigns you've created. If some of your work is confidential, you're welcome to share examples that best demonstrate your skills or describe your contributions.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in an interview. Depending on the stage of the process, candidates may also be asked to complete a brief practical assignment focused on AI-assisted content creation, SEO, and digital campaign execution. This allows us to better understand your approach, creativity, and problem-solving skills in a practical setting.

jobs.title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
jobs.description:
Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Staff Engineer (m/f/d)

Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

Do you think in systems and lead by doing? At Solactive, we are looking for a Staff Engineer to drive the technical direction and architectural evolution of our Index Setup platform, building scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Own the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions for index management and future platform capabilities.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
  • Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
  • Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery.

  • Experience with React / TypeScript frontend development in product teams owning full-stack delivery.
  • Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into pragmatic technical solutions.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • Modern Culture: Enjoy our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take over responsibility from day one and build relationships in- and outside of the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days, plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package.
  • Special Benefits: Job ticket, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space with ergonomic set-up, employee lounge, and free beverages and fruits.
  • Community & Networking: Engage in our various networking events.
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offers.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
jobs.description:
Senior People Ops Manager (International)

About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

• Ability to use interactive computer programs
• Good written/ verbal communication skills with a strong command of English language and grammar; good organizational, analytical/problem solving skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work productively with minimal supervision

• Strong customer focus and excellent interpersonal skills
• Proven flexibility and adaptability
• Ability to work in a team environment and independently as needed

Working Conditions and Environment:

jobs.description:
Staff Engineer (IT Automation & AI-native Transformation)

SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

Location Requirement:

This role is open to candidates currently based in and legally authorized to work in the UK, Portugal, Germany or Ireland. We are unable to consider applicants outside these locations.

Are you a visionary Staff Engineer, excited about pushing the boundaries of automation and artificial intelligence deployed across a whole company? We're seeking an exceptional candidate to join our IT Engineering team to build the foundation for our AI-native future, in one of the industry's fastest growing SaaS scale-ups.

Things no-one seems to know yet:

  • How to make traditional automation & productivity tools consistently useful across a whole business in a post-AI world

  • How to balance traditional tools against foundation models and agentic working

  • How to enable (and protect) citizen builders to use spec-driven design and self-built AI-agents to actually change the organisation, reliably, safely and at scale

We want you to solve these problems.

Here's how you'll make a difference:

  • Test-bed: Architect, build and iterate a toolchain fusing traditional automation and productivity tools (n8n, google workspace, etc) with spec-driven design and agentic working, test out on IT and Security

  • Iterate: Advocate, mentor and enable other early adopter teams to use our platforms, get value, provide feedback, iterate the platform

  • Standardise: Build self-sustaining cultural practices across the organisation, enable whole departments, scale the platform for everyone

  • Drive the evolution of IT operations towards an all-encompassing *-as-code infrastructure model through hands-on architecture and design

  • Contribute to the IT/Sec Operating System as we move wholesale to build-not-buy teams

  • Mentor and level up the existing IT engineering team, then whole departments, serving as a technical guide to accelerate skills transfer and foster a strong, collaborative engineering culture

  • Champion and advocate for our shared automation and AI platforms and methodologies, driving cross-departmental adoption to break down operational silos.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a Staff Engineer level, ideally within an established, successful, cloud-native hypergrowth SaaS environment

  • Hands-on builder and systems thinker - A background that includes hands-on coding, ideally in a platform or SRE team. IT experience is secondary, we need builders who can help others build better

  • A track record of successful AI-native adoption, showcasing how you've successfully moved workflows beyond experimental prompts into robust, production-grade automated workflows or agents

  • Deep technical mastery of at least some of: infrastructure-as-code, modern CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions) and enterprise-grade workflow orchestration (e.g., n8n, Zapier)

  • A pragmatic engineering mindset: You understand that while agentic working is fast and flexible, it brings significant utilization costs; you know how to design hybrid architectures that balance speed with financial efficiency. When faced with a complex problem, you instinctively break it down

  • Great leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills: The biggest challenge is always people, not technology. You treat internal teams as your customers and excel at explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical "citizen coders" and executive stakeholders alike.

What you will get in return:

  • A mandate from the CEO to massively accelerate our AI-native transformation in every role, actually solving the AI-related questions that we’re all asking, at speed and scale

  • A company comfortable with rapid change and iterative development - We love experiments that fail, as long as we learn from them

  • Collaborative and highly supportive IT and Security team around you - We prize a safe and enjoyable working environment, good work-life balance and solid mental health above all other things

  • Close relationships with super-smart, highly engaged peers across G&A, GTM and Product Engineering

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

 

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.




What you’ll do

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.

    •  

    What you’ll need to succeed

A critical priority for this role will be to identify and capitalize on the market's shift toward Identity for AI. As organizations rapidly adopt AI agents, autonomous systems, and AI-powered applications, traditional approaches to identity and access are evolving. The Director, Sales will help position Ping Identity at the forefront of this transformation, working with customers to address emerging requirements around AI agent identity, machine identity, authentication, authorization, governance, and secure access for AI-driven environments.

  • Lead the regional team in achieving and exceeding revenue, bookings, pipeline, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion targets.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Professional Services, Finance, Legal, and other functions to ensure regional strategies reflect customer needs and market dynamics.
  • Establish strong regional sales processes, operating rhythms, forecasting discipline, and performance management practices.
  • Monitor regional sales performance, pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, bookings, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion metrics, providing actionable insights to executive leadership.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive dynamics across the identity, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, and enterprise technology markets.
  • Identify emerging market trends and translate them into actionable strategies for Ping Identity's regional growth.
  • Build and manage relationships with strategic channel partners, resellers, distributors, systems integrators, cloud providers, and technology alliances.
  • Develop joint go-to-market strategies with strategic partners to expand Ping Identity's reach across Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia & Malaysia
  • Develop an ecosystem strategy around Identity for AI, identifying partnerships and alliances that can accelerate adoption and strengthen Ping Identity's position in the emerging market.
  • Represent Ping Identity at major industry events, conferences, customer forums, executive briefings, and partner engagements across the region.
  • Act as the primary regional advocate for customer and market requirements, influencing product strategy and investment priorities through market intelligence and customer feedback.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, professional development, and customer success across the regional organization.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years experience of leading enterprise cybersecurity/SaaS sales teams in with responsibility for regional revenue, teams, and business performance.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth, customer acquisition, market expansion, and strategic account development across Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia & Malaysia
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute multi-country go-to-market strategies.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology sales, complex sales cycles, account management, forecasting, pipeline management, and value-based selling.
  • Experience selling to senior executives, including CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and other technology and business leaders.
  • Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, coach, and develop high-performing sales teams
  • Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, including the ability to interpret market trends, competitive intelligence, customer requirements, and sales performance data.
  • Ability to operate effectively across diverse cultures, markets, and business environments.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, identity, cloud, digital transformation, and emerging AI security trends.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field.
  • Eligibility to work in Singapore

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Security, Customer Identity, Workforce Identity, cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise software.
  • Understanding of the evolving Identity for AI landscape and the security challenges associated with AI agents, autonomous systems, and non-human identities.
  • Experience developing new markets or establishing technology companies as market leaders within the defined region
  • Strong relationships with systems integrators, distributors, resellers, cloud providers, technology partners, and strategic alliances.
  • Familiarity with CRM, sales enablement, analytics, forecasting, and revenue operations platforms.
  • Strong understanding of the regulatory, competitive, economic, and technology environment across the defined region
  • Experience participating in industry forums and representing a technology company as a senior executive and market leader.

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

As Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Ops
jobs.description:
Senior Revenue Ops

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer II
jobs.description:
Controls Engineer II

The Controls Engineer II, Engineering Services designs and maintains the diagnostic infrastructure ICON's fleet depends on — building troubleshooting tools, guided diagnostics, telemetry-sourced health monitoring dashboards, and data-driven predictive maintenance models that move the fleet from reactive toward condition-based service. This role serves as the escalation point for complex controls failures across Field Engineering and customer teams, and is the technical authority others turn to when standard support can't resolve the issue.

This role is based at ICON’s headquarters in Austin, TX and reports to the Director of Engineering Services.

Responsibilities

  • Design feedback and escalation: Diagnose and resolve complex issues involving PLCs, HMIs, SCADA and industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet and DeviceNet.
  • Identify and report design, reliability and maintenance problems or software bugs to design and software engineering teams to facilitate root‑cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Network and integration support: Assist with issues related to control system networking, including configuring communication devices and integrating control hardware with enterprise systems. Collaborate with electrical, mechanical and IT teams to ensure seamless integration.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and support: Respond to situations where first‑line support cannot isolate or fix problems in malfunctioning control systems.
  • Field Engineering training: Develop and deliver training for the Field Engineering team on control system operation, maintenance, and configuration — building the technical notes, how-to guides, and reference materials that raise the team's capability to support the fleet independently.
  • Customer liaison: Serve as a technical liaison to customers, providing guidance on operation, maintenance, and configuration of control systems; deliver remote training sessions and produce technical notes and how-to guides that improve customer understanding.
  • Regulatory compliance: Ensure that control systems comply with safety and regulatory standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA, IEC) and advise customers on best practices for safe operation.
  • Documentation and knowledge management: Update knowledge base articles, create troubleshooting documentation and share insights with global support teams to build organisational knowledge.
  • Continuous learning: Stay current on emerging control technologies, PLC/HMI software and industry trends to incorporate the latest advancements into support practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in industrial automation or control systems support.
  • Strong working knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and control network protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues in control systems.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and standards for industrial control systems.
  • Excellent communication and customer‑service skills; ability to manage customer expectations and document resolutions.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and maintain composure under pressure.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Prior startup experience.
  • Twincat 3 Object Oriented Structured Text development.
  • Solid conceptual understanding of 3d printing technology.
  • Ability to read and contribute to electrical schematics.
  • Self-starting attitude, excited to make things happen in new and ambiguous situations.
  • Superior ability to influence and collaborate with senior management and work across all levels of the organization.

jobs.title: Director, Partner Programs, Enablement, and Operations
jobs.description:
Director, Partner Programs, Enablement, and Operations

About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Role overview

Ping Identity is seeking a strategic, highly execution-oriented Director, Partner Programs, Enablement & Operations to build the operating system that helps our partners create pipeline, win business, and deliver customer outcomes.

This role brings together three connected disciplines: partner program design, partner enablement, and chief-of-staff-style operating leadership. You will translate channel strategy into repeatable programs, equip partners and internal teams to execute, and establish the planning, measurement, and decision cadence required to scale our partner business.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing a global partner program, facilitating an executive decision, building a practical enablement journey, and turning an ambiguous cross-functional priority into a clear plan with owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

What you will do

Build and evolve the partner programs portfolio

  • Design and manage a coherent partner-program framework spanning recruitment, onboarding, activation, specialization, co-selling, services readiness, incentives, recognition, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish transparent principles for partner segmentation, prioritization, investment, access to strategic initiatives, and progression through the partner lifecycle.
  • Create program requirements, benefits, governance, operating guidelines, and communications that are simple for field teams and partners to understand and use.
  • Develop repeatable frameworks for joint business planning, partner commitments, mutual action plans, strategic partner agreements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Operations to ensure programs are scalable, economically sound, and aligned to company priorities.

Lead partner enablement and activation

  • Define the minimum partner-ready package for priority products and motions, including messaging, use cases, demos, pricing and SKU guidance, sales plays, presales support, delivery readiness, and customer proof.
  • Build role-based enablement journeys for partner executives, sellers, solution architects, consultants, delivery teams, and customer-success stakeholders.
  • Establish a practical calendar of onboarding, training, certification, launch, and reinforcement activities tied to partner and business outcomes.
  • Create the feedback loop that continuously improves enablement content based on partner adoption, field usage, win/loss evidence, and customer results.
  • Coordinate with Revenue Enablement, Product, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Experience, Marketing, and regional alliances leaders to eliminate duplication and close readiness gaps.
  • Champion fast, iterative delivery: put useful assets in partners’ hands early, measure usage and impact, and improve them based on evidence.

Operate as a chief-of-staff for the partner organization

  • Establish the partner organization’s operating cadence, including annual and quarterly planning, weekly execution reviews, pipeline and forecast inspection, executive readouts, and action follow-through.
  • Convert strategic priorities into integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, QBRs, business reviews, and executive partner engagements with concise narratives, decision materials, and recommended actions.
  • Maintain a single view of strategic initiatives, partner commitments, risks, cross-functional dependencies, and overdue or blocked actions.
  • Build dashboards and operating metrics that connect partner activity to pipeline, sourced and influenced revenue, activation, enablement adoption, delivery readiness, customer outcomes, and return on investment.
  • Improve clarity around partner attribution, field rules of engagement, investment decisions, incentives, and the handoffs between direct sales and partners.
  • Surface trade-offs early, drive decisions to closure, and ensure commitments are translated into accountable execution.

Drive executive and cross-functional alignment

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and connective tissue across Channel Alliances, Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Experience, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations.
  • Build productive relationships with partner executives and internal leaders, earning credibility through sound judgment, responsiveness, and delivery.
  • Facilitate complex decisions where priorities, resources, or ownership are unclear.
  • Support strategic partner motions, including executive alignment, joint go-to-market planning, customer engagement, and mutual investment discussions.
  • Provide clear, data-informed recommendations to senior leadership on partner priorities, programs, enablement investments, and operating model improvements.

Build the capability and culture

  • Lead through influence across a distributed, global organization and build a high-accountability, partner-first culture.
  • Develop program, enablement, and operations capabilities through hiring, coaching, clear role design, reusable processes, and strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Establish standards for high-quality planning, communication, measurement, and follow-through.

What success looks like

In the first 12 months, you will:

  • Launch a clear partner-program and enablement operating model with defined ownership, governance, milestones, and success measures.
  • Establish a prioritized partner portfolio and transparent criteria for investment, access, activation, and progression.
  • Deliver a measurable enablement plan for priority products and partner motions, with adoption and business-impact reporting.
  • Improve the quality and consistency of partner pipeline inspection, attribution, forecasting, and executive reporting.
  • Create a dependable operating cadence that closes decisions, exposes risks early, and improves cross-functional execution.
  • Demonstrate stronger partner engagement, field adoption, and measurable contribution to pipeline, revenue, and customer outcomes.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 9–11 years of experience in partner programs, channel strategy, alliances, revenue operations, sales enablement, business operations, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in a software, cloud, cybersecurity, identity, or other technology ecosystem with complex partner motions.
  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling partner programs, enablement programs, or cross-functional operating models.
  • Strong program-management and operating-rhythm skills, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, metrics, and executive communication.
  • Ability to move between strategy and execution: define the model, make the plan, align stakeholders, and drive delivery.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong business judgment and comfort making recommendations with incomplete information.
  • Experience working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Services, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
  • High ownership, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with global system integrators, regional system integrators, distributors, resellers, cloud marketplaces, or technology partners.

Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI - Deployed
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI - Deployed

Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

 

Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI

 

About the Role

So much of the work society depends on is still slower and harder than it should be. Permits take months. Claims sit unresolved. And AI hasn't changed that — because the bottleneck isn't the models. It's the institutional context AI needs to do the work: rules, history, relationships, and judgment scattered across people, documents, and legacy systems.

BrainCo exists to fix that. We build agent-native operating systems for the institutions society depends on, and our products are the first of their kind in the world — we were the first, anywhere, to fully automate construction permitting, and we're now doing the same across insurance and other industries. There is no playbook here, because no one has built this before.

As a Machine Learning Engineer on Applied AI, your work begins where the demo ends: getting a model to look impressive is the easy part; making it a production decision system an institution stakes its process on is the job. The problems come in every shape — custom vision model pipelines that check blueprints against building codes at 95%+ accuracy, agents that untangle policy stacks to reveal coverage gaps, systems that predict from clinical records whether a patient is on their care path — and you'll own them end-to-end, from ambiguous customer problem to the eval that catches a whole class of errors.

This is frontier ML applied where it's hardest and matters most. The problems are underspecified, the documents are brutal, the accuracy bar is institutional-grade — and the feedback loops are real, because our systems move real workflows forward every day.

 

Who We're Looking For

You understand how machine learning actually works — not just the tooling, but the philosophy underneath: what a loss function really optimizes, how generalization breaks under distribution shift, why evaluation is where systems quietly go wrong. And you live at the bleeding edge of modern AI, with hard-won instincts for squeezing the most out of LLMs and agentic systems — prompting, fine-tuning, tool use, and reasoning. That combination is the job: you know when a fine-tuned segmentation model beats a VLM, when a rule engine beats both, and how to compose all three into a system more accurate than any single model. You treat frontier models as components to be measured, pushed, and engineered — never as magic.

Most of all, you're energized by building things that have never existed, and comfortable when the problem, the data, and the definition of success all have to be invented at once.

 

The Problems You'll Work On

Composite AI systems and credit assignment. Our most demanding systems chain vision transformers, segmentation models, VLM reasoning, and rule engines. When the pipeline is wrong, which component failed? One of the most interesting open problems in applied ML.

Document understanding beyond the frontier. Blueprints, site plans, policy stacks, contracts, clinical records — dense, multimodal documents that break off-the-shelf models. You'll build models that actually read them.

Agents that learn from real work. Our deployments generate verified, ground-truth outcomes on every decision — reward signals most labs can only simulate. You'll help design the data, evals, and training loops to build and fine-tune agents on them.

Evaluation as a product discipline. When a regulator has to trust your system, evals are the product. You'll build eval suites and failure-mode taxonomies rigorous enough to earn institutional sign-off.

Institutional Intelligence that compounds. Every verified correction improves the system twice: the corrected fact percolates to every application, and the system that builds the intelligence learns to build it better. You'll work on both loops.

 

In This Role, You Will:

Turn ambiguity into shipped systems — from no problem statement, no labeled data, and no agreed definition of success, to well-posed ML problems and production deployments.

Own AI systems end-to-end. There is no handoff: the person who trains the model owns its behavior in production.

Work at the research frontier with production stakes, applying LLMs, RL fine-tuning, and agentic systems where the output is a decision an institution acts on.

Work directly with the institutions we serve — permit reviewers, underwriters, compliance officers — to understand how decisions actually get made and ensure your systems change how the work gets done.

Engineer for production reality, navigating accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability in environments far messier than any benchmark.

Raise the bar across the company through design reviews, our internal paper club, and the shared playbook for AI systems institutions can trust.

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :

C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
